name: How much does it cost to install a Lazy Susan in an existing cabinet?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install a Lazy Susan in an existing cabinet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to install a Lazy Susan in an existing cabinet varies depending on the type of Lazy Susan (e.g., full-round, D-shaped, kidney-shaped), the material, and the complexity of the installation. For professional installation, labor costs will also be a factor. Generally, homeowners can expect to pay for the unit itself, which can range from $50 to $300+, plus several hours of labor. For an accurate quote, it is best to consult with a local general contractor who can assess your specific cabinet structure and provide a detailed estimate for parts and installation in your Bay Area home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on Lazy Susan type, material, and installation complexity, plus professional labor. Expect $50-$300+ for the unit.
